label: droppedEndRun: a change to the selection keeps the edit run, so one drag spans two selections
refusalIsSuccess: a click the kernel refuses is adopted and reported as a change
find: guard next.pick(id, kind, order: order, canAdd: { $0 != id || shown }) else { return false }
replace: _ = next.pick(id, kind, order: order, canAdd: { $0 != id || shown })

label: endsRunAlways: a click that changes nothing ends the edit run
canAddIgnored: a click picks a photo the collection hides
selectKeepsHidden: select(_:) keeps ids the collection doesn't show
noFirstPick: an arrow with nothing selected picks nothing
zeroColumnsKept: a zero column count reaches the kernel, so the arrow does nothing
